messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001153": Team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the reporting service's owners.  (about: team Dune, reporting service, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1001133": The reporting service is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1001130": As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service.  (about: Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000279" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000850" [decision]: As of 2025-12-05, reporting is owned by the Ember team, taking over from team Dune.  (about: team Dune, Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1000845": From 2025-12-05, the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not team Dune.  (about: team Dune, Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1001221": The Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.  (about: ledger service, Ember team, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1001226": As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the on-call rotation for the Ember team.  (about: Diego, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001229": As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego.  (about: Diego, Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000921": As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the on-call rotation for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000948" [decision]: The Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday.  (about: Atlas team, no-deploy Friday)
- memory_id "1000818": As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team.  (about: Diego, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000312" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000623" [constraint]: The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000212" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1001216": The Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, indexer, Tuesday's deploy)
